title: ON SENSITIVE ISSUES SUCH AS THOSE AFFECTING THE ENVIRONMENT AND CITIZENS' HEALTH, MAXIMUM TRANSPARENCY IS NEEDED. WHAT DOES GIDA HAVE TO SAY ABOUT IT?
answer: GIDA uses maximum transparency with respect to its work. Society has always welcomed citizens who had questions to ask, provided answers, given the maximum willingness to verify the doubts raised. And not only on days when they are open to the public but also at any other time. GIDA has adopted this line not only out of duty and ethical choice, but also out of direct interest. Interest in any responsibilities and, above all, in the possible consequences on the health of the people who attend the company on a daily basis, i.e. workers, technicians and administrators. GIDA must not and does not want to operate incorrectly and has no interest in doing so.
